1. You need an Android phone with NFC and MIFARE Classic read/write.
2. Get a "MIFARE Classic 1K CUID (gen2 magic)" card.
3. Pick a material/color in the library, tap "Write to card", and hold a blank CUID card to the back of your phone.
4. When done, stick the card on your spool and load it into the AMS.

Note: recent AMS firmware may detect some CUID (gen2) tags and brick them by writing bad data to block 0. Gen4/FUID tags are the most reliable. Use this tool only for interoperability/backup with filament and hardware you own.
